title: Product Knowledge Contract — Payload Schema (SUPERSEDED)
description: SUPERSEDED. This monolithic schema was split into three independent schemas when catalog.product-knowledge.v1 was migrated to meta-contract v2. Use: catalog.product.changed.schema.json, catalog.product.snapshot.schema.json, catalog.product.tombstone.schema.json. Kept for historical reference only.

products.description: Current published product catalog. Full snapshot on each delivery.

id.description: Stable identifier from ERP Core. Never reused after deletion.

base_price.description: Pre-tax base price. Tax is calculated by commerce.engine using tax.policy.v1.

published.description: False means the product exists in ERP but must not appear in the storefront.

attributes.description: Key-value pairs. Keys must conform to attribute_schema. Pending ADR-001.

attribute_schema.description: Declares which attribute keys are valid for this tenant's catalog, their semantic types, cardinality, and indexing flags. ADR-001 accepted with amendments; Amendments 3 (reference type) and 4 (label i18n) remain open.

version.description: SemVer version of this attribute schema, independent of the parent contract version. Allows consumers to detect breaking changes in the schema without a full contract version bump.

definitions.description: Ordered list of attribute definitions. Each entry declares one attribute key and its contract with Commerce Engine.
definitions.$comment: definitions[].key must be semantically unique across all entries. JSON Schema uniqueItems cannot enforce uniqueness by a nested property; key uniqueness must be validated in CI or in the contract validator.

key.description: Canonical dot-separated attribute identifier. Namespace prefix required. E.g. vehicle.brand, part.type, engine.displacement_cc.

data_type.description: Semantic type of the attribute value. Determines indexing strategy in Commerce Engine. 'reference' is declared but its resolution semantics are pending Amendment 3.

cardinality.description: Whether the attribute value for a product is a scalar (single) or a list (multiple). Determines whether products[].attributes[key] is expected to be a value or an array.
cardinality.$comment: Cross-validation of products[].attributes values against cardinality is not enforced at schema level in v1. This validation will be closed before contract moves to Stable.

nullable.description: If true, the attribute may be absent or null in a product's attributes map. The publisher must declare this explicitly; no default is assumed.

searchable.description: If true, Commerce Engine includes this attribute in full-text search indexing. The publisher must declare this explicitly.

filterable.description: If true, Commerce Engine builds an inverted index to support filter queries on this attribute. The publisher must declare this explicitly.

sortable.description: If true, Commerce Engine maintains a sort index for this attribute. The publisher must declare this explicitly.

facetable.description: If true, Commerce Engine exposes this attribute as a storefront facet. The publisher must declare this explicitly.

unit.description: Physical or semantic unit for the attribute value. Examples: year, mm, cm, cc, kg. Not restricted to a closed enum in v1.

label.description: Display label for storefront facets and filter UI.
label.$comment: ADR-001 Amendment 4 pending: i18n strategy not yet decided. Current type (string | null) is temporary. Will be resolved before contract moves to Stable. Options: translation key, per-locale map, or bare string for single-locale tenants.

publication_rules.description: Rules that determine whether a product is eligible for publication. Evaluated by ERP Core before including a product in the snapshot. Pending ADR-002.

requires_stock.description: If true, products with quantity_available = 0 are excluded from the snapshot.

requires_price.description: If true, products with base_price = 0 are excluded.

requires_image.description: If true, products without thumbnail_url are excluded.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this snapshot was generated
